recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, multi-layered collage featuring a dense triangular geometric pattern, bold oversized typography, and a halftone-screened photographic element of two figures in a close embrace.
coreVisualRelationships: Interlocking of large-scale letterforms with a repetitive geometric background
Contrast between vibrant neon pink/orange and a muted green/yellow pattern
Juxtaposition of rigid geometric grids with organic human forms
Layering of flat vector shapes over textured halftone photography
coreInvariants: Halftone dot texture on all photographic elements
Triangular repeating pattern in green and yellow
High-saturation magenta as a primary focal color

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale typography dominates the upper two-thirds; a photographic crop occupies the bottom third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large vertical stem of the central letterform acts as a central pillar.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top-left orange text, down the central pink vertical, and across the interlocking letters to the figures at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense and filled with pattern or texture.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Forest Green and Mustard Yellow (geometric background pattern)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright Orange (top-left text) and Black (bottom photographic area)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the foreground elements against a medium-value, busy background pattern.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight tracking causing glyphs to touch or overlap
Heavy stroke weight with minimal contrast
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'l' extended vertically to act as a compositional divider
Interlocking 'g' and 'i' to create a unified shape

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlaid on pattern, masking the photo

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic weight variation with color-coded hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the circular counters and geometric construction.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a background featuring a repeating pattern of small green and yellow triangles. In the bottom third, place a black-and-white halftone image of two people kissing, with a high-contrast, grainy texture. Add a small Victorian pointing hand icon on the left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay large, extra-bold lowercase sans-serif text in vibrant magenta. The letters should be tightly kerned so they touch. One letter should have a significantly elongated vertical stem.

verificationChecks: Ensure the halftone dots are visible in the photographic section.
Check that the magenta text is the most saturated element.
Verify the triangular pattern is consistent across the background.

adjustableVariables: Color of the primary display text
Subject of the bottom photographic element
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the figures
Unique hand-drawn flourishes on the pointing hand

mustAchieve: Clean vector edges on text against textured background
Rhythmic repetition in the geometric pattern

postGenerationChecks: Is the text lowercase and touching?
Is the halftone effect applied to the photo?
Is the triangular pattern green and yellow?
Is there a vibrant magenta focal point?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Geometric Pattern Background] + [Halftone Photo Crop at Bottom] + [Oversized Overlapping Lowercase Typography] + [High Saturation Color Palette].
